basics.name: Aidan McLean
basics.label: Full-Stack Developer
basics.status: Research Assistant @ McMaster Faculty of Engineering
basics.lede: I am a Full-Stack Developer, and I enjoy designing and developing solutions based on real needs. My most recent projects are a research platform at McMaster where researchers benchmark AI battery models, and a full-stack e-commerce platform for an independent record label.
basics.contactNote: Open to hearing about software development & IT work. The fastest way to reach me is email.

highlights: Architected and developed a full-stack research platform (Node.js/Express, TypeScript, React, PostgreSQL) that lets researchers submit and benchmark AI battery State-of-Charge models against one another, ranking submissions across 18+ evaluation metrics.

Delivered features end to end across the stack, from REST API endpoints to the React components consuming them, including model submission workflows, results export, an in-app notification system, and an administrative management console.

Designed the PostgreSQL schema (Drizzle ORM) covering authentication, model metadata, and evaluation history, and implemented cookie-based session authentication, rate limiting, and role-based access control across all protected routes.

Built an asynchronous evaluation pipeline that runs each submission in an isolated Docker container, enabling concurrent scoring of multiple models without cross-submission interference, and delivers results through the notification system and email.

Manage deployment on an Ubuntu server (Compute Canada's OpenStack cloud), including NGINX configuration, PM2 process management, and SSL/TLS certificate renewal; incorporate agentic AI development tools (e.g. Claude Code) into the workflow for debugging, code review, and infrastructure scripting.
Customized Drupal Webforms with JavaScript to implement dynamic form behaviour, validation, and improved user experience.
Built front-end integrations with Microsoft APIM to apply business logic, route requests securely, and connect forms to backend services.
Developed a TypeScript front-end application that integrated with an internal GIS map server to retrieve and visualize location-based data.
Picked up Drupal, APIM, and Power Automate on the job and put them straight to use on live production forms.
Documented APIs, workflows, and form logic so other developers could pick up the work without re-deriving it.

projects.name: Record Label E-Commerce Platform
projects.summary: A production storefront, admin console, and in-person point-of-sale for an independent record label, with dual-currency pricing, idempotent order processing, content management, role-based admin access, and per-currency reporting.
projects.detail: Built solo from the ground up and live in production since October 2026, handling real orders and payments online and in person. Both applications share one database, authentication layer, and component library in a TypeScript monorepo.
highlights: Designed and built a two-application platform, a public storefront and a staff admin on a shared Postgres database, covering the catalogue, inventory, checkout, order fulfilment, refunds, discounts, shipping, and local pickup.

Built a Stripe checkout that prices every order on the server and reserves stock while the customer pays, with webhook handling that records each order exactly once and a scheduled job that recovers any payment whose confirmation is lost.

Designed dual-currency pricing in USD and CAD, with prices set by hand in each currency rather than converted, and displayed each visitor's currency without giving up static page generation or causing layout shift.

Built a staff admin used both in the office and at live shows, with permission-based roles, two-factor sign-in, sales analytics by channel and currency, content management, a phone-first point of sale, and an append-only audit log of every change to money, inventory, and user data.

Secured the platform with validation on every server action, database-backed rate limits on sign-in and public forms, salted hashing in place of stored IP addresses, and error reports scrubbed of personal data. Deployed on Vercel and Neon with a GitHub Actions CI/CD pipeline, 142 unit tests, and automatic database migrations.

projects.name: SoC Model Benchmarking Platform
projects.summary: A research platform where teams upload AI battery State-of-Charge models and have them scored against a shared benchmark. Submissions are graded on 18+ metrics and ranked against every other entry.
highlights: Architected and developed a Node.js/Express (TypeScript) REST API serving a full-stack platform for AI model submission, automated sandboxed evaluation, and competitive leaderboard ranking across 18+ battery performance metrics.

Implemented cookie-based session authentication with rate limiting, email verification, and role-based access control middleware enforcing ownership-gated authorization across all protected API routes.
Designed a PostgreSQL schema spanning authentication, model metadata, file storage, and evaluation results, integrating BetterAuth for secure session and credential management.

Built an asynchronous Docker-based evaluation pipeline that spawns isolated containers per submission, captures structured scoring output, and delivers results to users via automated email notifications.

Deployed and maintained the production environment with Docker Compose, NGINX, PM2, and SSL/TLS, with structured logging and secure file handling including upload validation and path traversal prevention.
